text: Man: Uh, let me finish the newspaper first?
Woman: You’ve been saying that forever!
Man: Well, how about reading the business section of the newspaper together?
It’s about a bear and cat that becomes friends. [Okay] And these books too.
I thought you said one book.
Woman: My teacher, Mrs. Green, says you have to read to me every night, and the newspaper doesn’t count.
And let’s eat some popcorn and cookies while we’re reading.
Man: Well, it’s bedtime right now.
Once upon a time in a deep, dark forest, lived a brown bear . . .
